sentences.l1: The airplane flies in the sky.

sentences.l2: 空气从翅膀下面和上面走。
sentences.l1: Air goes along under the wings and over them.

sentences.l2: 下面的空气用力推翅膀，让飞机上去。
sentences.l1: The air underneath pushes hard on the wings, making the airplane go up.

sentences.l2: 飞机向前走的时候，空气不让它走快，这个叫阻力。
sentences.l1: When the airplane moves forward, the air does not let it go fast; this is called drag.

sentences.l2: 飞机要飞，需要大的升力和小的阻力。
sentences.l1: For an airplane to fly, it needs big lift and small drag.

sentences.l2: 工程师学物理，想办法让飞机飞得好。
sentences.l1: Engineers study physics and think of ways to make airplanes fly well.
They design the shape of the wings.

sentences.l2: 好的设计让飞机安全飞。
sentences.l1: A good design makes the airplane fly safely.
